The '''''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as the '''''Resurgent''-class Battlecruiser''', the '''Resurgent Star Destroyer''', or the '''First Order Star Destroyer''', was a model of [[battlecruiser]] and [[Star Destroyer]] built by [[Kuat-Entralla Engineering]]. It saw service in the [[First Order Navy]] in the [[Unknown Regions]] after the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]], and was later massively engaged at the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. As its name suggests, the ''Resurgent''-class was to demonstrate the might of the emergent [[First Order]] throughout [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Cross" /> The First Order Star Destroyer was still considered a new model by [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Before the Awakening">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref>

The ''Resurgent''-class was the embodiment of the new doctrine adopted by the First Order, which favored surgical strikes through the use of high quality weapons with parsimony and pragmatism. Where the old [[Galactic Empire]] had no qualms in sacrificing countless Star Destroyers, the First Order could not afford such losses and commissioned the Resurgent Star Destroyer to take over the now outdated [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class]]. Almost twice as big and much better equipped than its Imperial predecessor, the ''Resurgent''-class finally fixed the many flaws of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer.

Forming the backbone of the [[First Order Navy]], the Resurgent Star Destroyer was well ahead of its time and had virtually no equal by the time it entered into active service. Following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]] that saw the annihilation of much of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet|New Republic's Fleet]], the Resurgent Star Destroyer became the spearhead of the [[First Order]] in its ruthless conquest of the galaxy, successfully forcing many worlds into submission. When the [[First Order-Resistance War|galactic conflict]] against the [[Resistance]] broke out, the First Order Star Destroyer outclassed its opponents but suffered extensive and unnecessary losses, as demonstrated at the [[Battle of Oetchi]].

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
{{Quote|Wait, what just showed up? A Star Destroyer… A really big, tremendously huge Star Destroyer.|[[Kazuda Xiono]]|<ref name="No Escape: Part 2">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}</ref>}}
Almost twice the length of the Old Empire's [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], the ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer<ref name="TLJ:ICS Star Destroyer Note">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' confirms that the ship is indeed called a Star Destroyer, although its class is a Battlecruiser.</ref> (also known as ''Resurgent''-class Battlecruiser, Resurgent Star Destroyer, or First Order Star Destroyer)<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> was 2,915.81 meters in length and emulated the dagger-shaped design of its former ''Imperial''-class vessels. Eight ''Resurgent''-class vessels could dock with a single [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />

Designed for advanced ship-to-ship combat capabilities, it served as a symbol of the First Order's power, inspiring awe in the Order's enemies and pride within its ranks.<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> Improving on the design of [[Imperial Era]] vessels, the ship featured hull structural bracing in its midsection. Much of the bow was split in two along the side, housing open space, supported by a truss structure.<ref name="Cross" />

===Crew requirements===
[[File:Resurgent-class_Star_Destroyer-Schematics-SW_Card_Trader.png|thumb|left|200px|''Resurgent''-class Battlecruiser schematics]]
''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers featured a complement of 19,000 [[officer]]s and 55,000 enlisted personnel. To keep such a large ship in operation, starship crews were forced to work closely together and alternate each [[standard day]] into six four-hour-long shifts, divided among three crew sections. This would foster a strong sense of unity and team identity. Access to command systems and other areas of First Order vessels and installations were denied to enlisted personnel, requiring the properly coded rank cylinders worn by officers. With many young fleet officers having been trained aboard these new<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> [[battlecruiser]]s<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> for their entire lives, most considered these warships as their homes.<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" />

''Resurgent''-class vessels featured a crew recreation area on the lower part of the midsection. Upper habitation levels near the primary command bridge were reserved for senior command staff. [[First Order Special Forces]] personnel stationed on the ship utilized barracks near senior command domiciles. Domiciles for First Order pilots had four cupboards, and four beds which were split into two bunkbeds. Each cupboard was reserved for each pilot, containing their weapons, with the pilot`s serial number written in Aurebesh on the door. In the domiciles were four ladders which would aid pilots in reaching the top bunkbed. The ship's sickbay was located above the [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] barracks in the bow section of the ship before the forward heavy turbolaser batteries.<ref name="Cross" /> The ships also featured meeting rooms in which high ranking officials, such as the First Order Supreme Council, could meet and discuss important matters.<ref name="Episode IX" />

''Resurgent''-class vessels maintained a complement of over 8,000 stormtroopers (a full [[legion]]) who had access to a training complex below their barracks. While stormtroopers followed their chain of command while aboard fleet vessels—with a captain of the guard serving as the ultimate authority over the troopers—during alerts stormtroopers were instructed to follow the orders of any officer regardless of branch of service. First Order Special Forces personnel were also stationed on the vessel. A TIE pilot training and briefing complex existed adjacent to the lateral port hangar, while engineering personnel habitation areas were located at the bottom of the ship, near the reactor core. The ship featured a detention center in its upper midsection, slightly closer to the bow of the vessel. Just like its predecessors, the ''Resurgent''-class featured Rebaxan Columni [[MSE-6 series repair droid]]s to serve as messenger, repair and custodial assistants.<ref name="Cross" /><ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" />

===Design===
While its size invoked memories of [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]], the design also mimicked the [[Galactic Republic|Republic's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. The ventral flight deck, side hangars, and long keel are leftovers from the [[Clone Wars]]. More efficient flight decks and hangar bays allowed the ''Resurgent''-class to launch its full complement of fighters much faster than Imperial warships could. Other design flaws in Imperial ships such as the exposed bridge were also fixed.<ref name="CVNE">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref>

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Featuring over 1,500 [[turbolaser]]s and [[ion cannon]]s,<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> ''Resurgent''-class vessels were designed for orbital assaults and slugging matches with enemy ships. Powerful turbolaser batteries allowed for overloading enemy shields and punching through thick armor, along with orbital bombardments capable of reducing planetary surfaces to molten slag. Upgraded from Imperial Era turbolasers, the ''Resurgent''-class delivered more firepower and had a faster recharge rate. Stemming from [[Kyber crystal|kyber focusing crystals]] harvested from a secret source deep in the [[Unknown Regions]], other captains clamored for upgrades to their warships, only to be denied as military-grade crystals were in short supply. Only the most prestigious and important vessels were allowed this advanced weaponry, along with the Order's highest ranks. Much like its Imperial predecessors, the ''Resurgent'' destroyer featured eight dorsal heavy turbolaser turrets in pairs of four on either side of its main tower,<ref name="Cross" /> in addition to two triple-barreled heavy turbolaser cannons on its underside in front of its main hangar.<ref name="Episode VII" />

[[File:Finalizer_ventral_cannons.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ventral missile cannons of a ''Resurgent''-class vessel.]]
Smaller point-defense turrets and missile emplacements served as complements to the heavy weapons, being able to track and destroy smaller and more agile ships. Both starboard and port sides of the stern featured standard turbolaser batteries, while heavy turbolaser turrets and an axial defense turret were located at the bow. The ship's turret firing control center was located at the aft and was protected underneath the larger rear portion of the ship. Ion cannon targeting was located on the ship's port side near the front.<ref name="Ships of the Galaxy" /> [[Multi-spectrum sensor tower]]s were located near the primary command bridge and aided in target acquisition.<ref name="Cross" />

The ship's tractor beam projector was located at the very tip of the bow, while the flight deck deflector shield projector was located a short distance behind. The ship's main hull deflector shield projectors were located on both the port and starboard stern sections, while a single domed-shaped bridge deflector shield projector encased the command bridge and its occupants, aided by a bridge deflector augmenter further up the ship's keel line. A bridge point-defense turret also helped further defend the bridge from starfighter attack.<ref name="Cross" />

===Complement===
[[File:Finalizer_hangar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|One of the ''Finalizer''{{'s}} hangars, containing several TIE/sf fighters and Atmospheric Assault Landers.]]
''Resurgent''-class<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> Battlecruisers<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> typically carried two starfighter wings of both [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE/fo]] and [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s.<ref name="Cross" />

The ship featured both lateral starboard and port hangar entrances, with hangar flight control bridges overseeing activities in both bays. Unlike former ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers, TIE fighters were brought in from storage deeper within the vessel from launching racks, from where they would exit into space. The main hangar was positioned on the vessel's underbelly, where a docking claw aided vessels in landing and departing. The logistics hangar reception bay and ground vehicle storage were located near the main hangar. Another lateral flight deck was located in the ship's bow and was used as a staging area for full-scale invasion operations. Overall, the ''Resurgent''-class could launch its full complement of starfighters and assault ships much quicker than its predecessors in the [[Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Cross" />

For ground assault, a ''Resurgent''-class Battlecruisers carried 100 [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|Atmospheric Assault Landers]],<ref name="Episode VII" /> [[Light Infantry Utility Vehicle|several]] [[Elite speeder bike|speeders]], many [[All Terrain Mobile Artillery|self]] [[All Terrain MegaCaliber Six|propelled]] [[Superlaser siege cannon|artillery piece]], at least some [[First Order All Terrain Armored Transport|ground]] troop [[Troop transport|transports]], numerous [[Xi-class light shuttle|''Xi''-class]]<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> and [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class shuttles]],<ref name="Episode VII" /> one [[prefabricated ground base]], and more than 8,000 stormtroopers.<ref name="Cross" />

===Propulsion systems===
[[File:FinalizerAft-TLJTOG.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Resurgent''-class sported three Destroyer Ion Engines and eight Gemon-8 ion engines.]]
The ''Resurgent''-class was powered by a single, large [[III-a1a primary hypermatter-annihilation reactor]] housed within a dome-shaped reactor containment vessel on the ship's underbelly. The massive reactor was supported by a reinforced reactor superstructure and hull chassis. The reactor engineering control deck oversaw reactor-based activities. The large atmospheric processing complex and reactant ducts were located behind the reactor containment vessel.<ref name="Cross" />

The ship was propelled by eleven engines, with three large [[Kuat Drive Yards|KDY]] [[Destroyer Ion Engine]]s and eight smaller [[Gemon-8 ion engine]]s.<ref name="Ships of the Galaxy" /> These engines required a subsidiary reactor, reactant silos and isotope containment wells at the stern. There, extra power would be derived while the coolant silo and pumps would help lower the temperature of the massive engines. Around the large, circular engines were the main engine thrust nozzles, while the smaller engines would utilize secondary thrust nozzles to help bring greater control over the ship. The main engines were attached to magnetic turbines, along with an acceleration compensator. While the engines had a standard [[Sublight engine|sublight]] speed of 70 [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]],<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" /> in a straight line and at full throttle, the ''Resurgent''-class could be faster than a TIE/fo space superiority fighter, which had a speed of 130 MGLT; however doing so would negate any maneuverability and require a staggering amount of counter-thrust to execute the slightest maneuver. Thus, only the most reckless commanders traded the ship's maneuverability for its speed.<ref name="Before the Awakening" /> The hyperdrive generator was located at the very end of the ship's aft section.<ref name="Cross" />

===Bridge tower===
[[File:Resurgent-class_Bridge_view.png|thumb|left|250px|The bridge of a ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer.]]
Learning lessons from the loss of the ''[[Executor]]'' during the [[Battle of Endor]], the ''Resurgent''-class destroyer featured an off-center, better-protected command bridge along with increased redundancy in command and control systems. No longer having the exposed conning towers of older Imperial Era vessels, bridge height was reduced significantly. In addition, an emergency bridge was located in the ship's midsection and was not exposed but built into the existing structure of the vessel. There, standby personnel would take control of the vessel's activities if the primary bridge were to be taken out of action.<ref name="Cross" />

Additionally, sunken data pits continued to be used following the designs from Clone Wars-era [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], owing to their importance in denoting command hierarchy. Simplified bridge displays with limited colors further aided bridge crews in disseminating large amounts of complex data faster than before.<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> Like the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers before them, the ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer bridge designs were deliberately modeled to reflect an emphasis on command hierarchical structures, to such an extent that the commanding officers were literally afforded a higher platform than the non-commissioned officers via sunken [[Data pit|pits]].<ref name="TLJ:TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
Following the [[Galactic Empire]]'s defeat at the [[Battle of Jakku]] and the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]], its successor state known as the First Order rose to power in the [[Unknown Regions]], eventually it ordered the construction of the new ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers on recently constructed shipyards and secret facilities in the galaxy's vast frontier, though their very construction was illegal by the Concordance.<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /><ref name="Cross" /> It would still be considered a new model shortly before the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Before the Awakening" />

[[File:StormtrooperStandingGuard-PoeDameron14.png|thumb|right|250px|The forces of the First Order used the ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers as they expanded.]]
Taking inspiration from the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers of the Old Empire, but lacking the resources to construct huge numbers of these capital ships, First Order designs would consciously emulate the psychological factor of the previous Imperial Era ships. The ship's bow, flight deck, side hangars, and prominent keel would share similarities to the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], which reflected renewed appreciation among First Order tacticians for capital ships' role as carriers.<ref name="Cross" />

Further improvements in a better protected bridge tower along with quicker fighter-combat reaction time, the ''Resurgent''-class served as the mainstay of the First Order Navy, replacing the aging ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers in service.<ref name="Cross" /><ref name="Before the Awakening" /> Despite the size of the ''Resurgent''-class, the [[Resistance]]'s intelligence branch suspected that the [[First Order]] had even larger [[warship]]s in development.<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" />

[[File:ResurgentClassStarDestroyer-NoEscapePart2.jpg|left|thumb|268x268px|The ''Thunderer'', a ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer on [[Castilon]]]]
[[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] and [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] used the ''[[Finalizer]]'', the lead ship of the ''Resurgent''-class, 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the Battle of Endor<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> in the search for [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]], and launched the [[Attack on Tuanul]] from the command ship.<ref name="Episode VII" /> Thirty ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers,<ref name="Ships FOR">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}}</ref> including the ''Finalizer'', the [[Harbinger (Resurgent-class)|''Harbinger'']] and ''[[Conqueror]]'', also proceeded to participate in the [[Battle of Oetchi]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /><ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> The Resistance during that time knew that at least 30 ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers were present among the First Order forces,<ref name="TLJ:TVD" /> but 20 of them were destroyed in [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]]'s [[ramming]] [[Holdo maneuver|attack]].<ref name="Poe 31">[[Poe Dameron 31|''Poe Dameron'' 31]]</ref>

At least 17 ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers, including the ''Finalizer'', were present at the planet [[Tah'Nuhna]] along with one [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] during the First Order's [[Destruction of Tah'Nuhna|destruction]] of the planet.<ref name="Allegiance 1" /> Afterwards, the ''Finalizer'' was present at Batuu along with two other ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers. They engaged Resistance forces above the planet.<ref name="ROTR">{{GEAttr|Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance|Rise of the Resistance}}</ref> A fleet of 14 ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers arrived in the [[Aeos system]] after a [[Team Colossus|Resistance cell]] led by [[Kazuda Xiono]] was on the planet [[Aeos Prime]]. The ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers [[Suppression of the Aeos system|bombarded]] the planet, killing many [[Aeosian]]s.<ref name="The Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:Uprising_on_Cloud_City.png|thumb|right|250px|Several ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers were destroyed across the galaxy.]]
The ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> commanded the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet, the [[Final Order]], during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. The ship was destroyed when [[Finn]] and [[Jannah]] used one of its own turbolasers to destroy the command deck. The crippled ship then crashed into [[Exegol]]'s surface and exploded. After the [[Sith]]'s defeat, several ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers were later attacked by the citizens of the galaxy during an [[uprising against the First Order]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

The ''Resurgent''-class<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> Battlecruiser<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> first appeared in the second teaser trailer for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] on [[April 16]], [[2015]].<ref name="TFA second teaser">{{SWYouTube|ngElkyQ6Rhs|Star Wars: The Force Awakens Official Teaser #2|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-force-awakens-official-teaser-2}}</ref> The ship's full name, the "''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer," was revealed in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', released on [[December 18]] along with the film.<ref name="Cross" /> However, the book's author [[Jason Fry]] later announced that the information on the ''Finalizer'' from the book had been revised, changing up the complement and reclassifying it as the "''Resurgent''-class Battlecruiser"—changes that would be reflected in future printings of the reference book.<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" />

For the next generation<ref name="The Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> of battlecruisers,<ref name="TFA Secret Inside" /> many design concepts were considered, including one with a negative space in the bow, similar to the [[W:c:memory-alpha:USS Vengeance|USS ''Vengeance'']] in [[J.J. Abrams]]' [[2013]] film [[Wikipedia:Star Trek Into Darkness|''Star Trek into Darkness'']].<ref name="The Art" />
